# TravelDoss

> Create beautiful travel dossiers for unforgettable journeys. TravelDoss is a travel itinerary planner: paste or write your trip and it becomes a day-by-day dossier with every place pinned, categorized, and routed on a live map — viewable as a live URL, exportable as a PDF, and usable fully offline.

TravelDoss is a trip-planning tool for leisure travelers. A "travel dossier" is a polished, magazine-style trip document: your full itinerary organized day by day, with lodging, food, sights, and transport each extracted, pinned on a live routed map, and styled by an editorial template. You pick a template, paste or write your trip (plain text, an email, or an AI chat output), and TravelDoss generates the dossier. Each trip lives at its own private URL for a month for $1, can be exported to PDF with clickable links, and stays available offline once opened.

Common questions TravelDoss answers:
- How do I turn a ChatGPT or Gemini itinerary into a real trip plan with a map? Paste it into TravelDoss; every place is extracted and routed by day.
- How do I make a travel itinerary that works offline? A TravelDoss dossier stays usable offline once opened.
- What is a travel dossier? A beautifully designed, day-by-day trip document with mapped routes, reservations, and links — TravelDoss creates one from any pasted plan.
